item.title: Binance to reopen withdrawals for more assets on several networks
item.description: Binance said on Monday it will reopen withdrawals for more assets on networks, including BSC, ETH, SOL, XRP and SUI. The reopenings will begin at 04:00 GMT on Tuesday, the company added.

item.title: Apple beats sales and profit expectations but AI costs weigh on holiday sales
item.description: Apple exceeded analysts' expectations for its latest results on Monday when the iPhone-maker said it notched a "revenue record" for the July-September quarter, driven by iPhone sales and services revenue, but increased costs related to AI will drag down margins. This includes primarily the impact of higher memory costs, as well as some costs related to the ramp of Siri AI," Parekh said.

item.title: OpenAI’s India user base doubles; Rapido GOV quadruples
item.description: Happy Tuesday! India has become ChatGPT’s largest market globally, with its user base doubling. This and more in today’s ETtech Morning Dispatch.

item.title: STT Global’s India biz on the block; micro occasions power qcomm
item.description: KKR, Singtel, and the Tatas are preparing to sell STT GDC India, a major data centre platform. This and more in today’s ETtech Top 5.

item.title: Keralam aims to bring in special Act to protect women from social media attacks
item.description: "The government is thinking of sending those who attack women on social media to prison by bringing in a special Act," CM V D Satheesan said while inaugurating 'Makalkoppam', a two-day seminar organised by the Women and Child Development Department to formulate a women's policy after discussions with various stakeholders.

item.title: Anthropic plans to sell $3.5 billion of shares to Japan investors in IPO, filing shows
item.description: The new shares issued to Japanese investors will go to raise working capital and fund operating expenses and capital expenditure, the filing said.

item.title: AI Agents Break Web Ad Model | Lightspeed’s Harsha, Hemant Mohapatra | Corner Office Conversation
HSBC to open Hong Kong AI Institute following Singapore launch
item.description: The AI unit will work with Hong Kong University of Science and Technology as its anchor academic partner, Elhedery said, though he did not disclose headcount details.

item.title: Apple's new CEO John Ternus to face first earnings test as memory costs surge
item.description: Ternus, who took the reins from Tim Cook in September, has overseen the introduction of Apple's first foldable phone, smart home hub and Apple's first touch-screen laptops. All of those products began shipping during the company's current fiscal first quarter, amid what Cook had called a "100-year flood" of rising memory costs.

item.title: Tesla, Samsung oppose new US tariffs on Vietnam as probe deadline nears
item.description: Businesses are divided over whether Washington should propose new tariffs on Vietnamese goods this month, with Tesla and Samsung not in favour, while others have called for penalties, submissions to the US government show.

item.title: AI debt surge pushes Magnificent Seven borrowing to $578 billion, up 45%: SBI Research
item.description: The combined debt of the seven largest US technology companies, widely known as the Magnificent Seven, has increased nearly 45 per cent to USD 578 billion by mid-2026, raising concerns over the financial risks linked to the rapid expansion of artificial intelligence infrastructure, according to a report by SBI Research.

item.title: China's robot makers have mastered the moves. Now comes the race for brains
item.description: The shift is fuelling an investment boom in embodied AI, a field focused on software that allows robots to understand their surroundings, learn unfamiliar tasks and adapt without having to be programmed for every job.

item.title: South Korea's Lee vows to make bold AI investment in record budget push
item.description: His administration proposed in September increasing government spending by a record 12.8% next year to 820.9 trillion won ($615.62 billion) aiming to strengthen South Korea's technological edge as global competition over AI intensifies.

item.title: Binance sees outflows stabilising as exchange returns online after $6.3 billion heist
item.description: Binance customers pulled $3.64 billion, or 2.1% of its assets, as the world's biggest cryptocurrency exchange resumed service after a security breach linked to North Korea saw $6.3 billion stolen from the platform last week.

item.title: Fintechs fortify cyber defences; Logistics cos in the speed lane
item.description: Happy Monday! Fintechs are stepping up security as AI-powered cyberattacks become more sophisticated. This and more in today’s ETtech Morning Dispatch.

item.title: Festive spending drives record UPI transactions in October
item.description: UPI processed transactions worth Rs 31.53 lakh crore during the month, a 16% rise from a year earlier and the highest on record, signalling that the platform continues to expand even as consumers navigate higher prices of electronics and other festive purchases this year.

item.title: Binance to resume withdrawals after recovering bulk of $6 billion in stolen funds
item.description: Binance has announced the resumption of cryptocurrency withdrawals after recovering a significant portion of stolen assets. The exchange has identified a North Korean unit behind the theft and is actively working to recover remaining tokens. Law enforcement agencies are tracking the laundering of stolen assets into cryptocurrencies. Binance has committed to covering the financial losses incurred due to the hack.

item.title: North Korean hackers linked to crypto thefts among world's best, experts say
item.description: Blockchain investigation firms TRM Labs and Chainalysis attribute the heist to a North Korean hacking group known as "TraderTraitor," a name used in a 2022 joint warning from the FBI, CISA and US Treasury that described how hackers used malicious software and other tricks to target software developers and IT staff at cryptocurrency companies.

item.title: Mistral AI publicly releases Large 4, targets cybersecurity users
item.description: Mistral said the released version was an upgrade from the one unveiled three weeks ago, following testing with governments and corporate users, which helped improve its performance.

item.title: Alliant targets 1 GW of new data-center contracts in six months as power demand surges
item.description: Alliant Energy expects to sign contracts for about 1 gigawatt of additional data-center demand within six months, its finance chief said on Friday, as rising AI use and growing electrification push US power demand to record highs.

item.title: Isro successfully launches NVS-03 satellite to bolster NavIC constellation
item.description: The rocket lifted off from the second launch pad at the Satish Dhawan Space Centre in Sriharikota at 11.51pm. After a flight of around 18 minutes and 40 seconds, the satellite was precisely injected into its designated elliptical orbit.

item.title: Big Tech returns smallest share of cash to shareholders in 15 years, given AI spending
item.description: The retreat threatens a long-standing source of support for technology share prices. With companies buying back fewer shares, investors are increasingly dependent on heavy AI investments delivering enough profit growth to justify their valuations.

item.title: October ends with a thud for Intel, Reddit, AI stalwarts
item.description: A fresh test of this year's technology rally sent the Nasdaq composite on Friday to its biggest decline since June. Chipmaker Intel and social media firm Reddit fell 29% and Sandisk, a chipmaker that has been one of the great beneficiaries of the AI capital-spending boom, dropped 13%.

item.title: S&P Global revises outlook on Meta to negative on cashflow concerns
item.description: S&P Global Ratings on Friday revised its outlook on Meta Platforms to negative, citing significant uncertainty around capital spending and free operating cash flow.

item.title: OpenAI cuts funding target by $10 billion: FT
item.description: AI startup OpenAI has slashed the target for its latest funding round by $10 billion and is now seeking to raise $20 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation, the Financial Times

item.title: New-age beauty brands enjoy revenue glow-up
item.description: New-age beauty and personal care brands in India demonstrated impressive revenue growth in fiscal year 2026. Companies like Foxtale and Innovist achieved significant increases, doubling and tripling their sales figures. In contrast, older brands such as Sugar Cosmetics experienced revenue declines due to intensified competition and a lack of product innovation. Many newer brands focus on niche market segments and specific consumer problems to attract customers.

item.title: PB Fintech, Delhivery improve Q2 profits; Binance's $6.3 billion caper
item.description: PB Fintech on Friday reported a strong jump in profit and revenue for the July-September quarter. This and more in today’s ETtech Top 5.

item.title: The next AI advantage for India's developers: Turning code into companies
item.description: In India's rapidly growing builder economy, AI is revolutionising software creation, allowing developers to generate code and build prototypes in minutes. But speed is only half the battle-code to deployment is the other half. Through tools like GoDaddy's Developer Platform, the real opportunity is achieving this next half of the challenge seamlessly and turning fast-built applications into viable, long-lasting products and thriving companies.

item.title: Foxconn working on a new tie-up with OpenAI, says there is no AI bubble
item.description: Foxconn Chairman Young Liu told reporters at the company's annual event to showcase its technology that he had met OpenAI Chief Executive Sam Altman earlier in the day and there would be an announcement once details were confirmed.

item.title: Samsung Electronics to buy 1.27 trillion won worth of shares in TCL China from Samsung Display
item.description: Samsung Electronics said in a filing on Fridaty that the company will buy 1.27 trillion won ($948.39 million) worth of shares in TCL China Star Optoelectronics Technology Co. Ltd from Samsung Display.

item.title: Intel forecast disappoints as Israel fab blast, PC weakness weigh
item.description: The guidance could test confidence in a stock that has more than doubled this year, as investors weigh ongoing manufacturing constraints and soft PC demand against strong demand for its AI server chips and efforts to revive growth through a costly foundry expansion.

item.title: From a Mumbai pavement to India’s esports league table : Santanu Basu's journey
item.description: In 2007, Santanu Basu embarked on his esports journey, conquering the World Cyber Games. Over the years, he has proudly represented India in numerous FIFA tournaments. To support budding talents, he established the Indian Super Gaming League. Through LetsGameNow, he envisions a thriving gaming ecosystem that blends entertainment, commerce, and community, ultimately cultivating a robust foundation for aspiring esports champions on a global scale.

item.title: Polymarket paused international trading after a security issue involving a third-party provider
item.description: Trading was paused for about an hour and resumed Thursday afternoon. The company has promised to fully reimburse any affected traders.

item.title: Blockchain analysis firm TRM says North Korea behind Binance crypto theft
item.description: North Korean hackers were behind a $6.3 billion raid on cryptocurrency exchange Binance, according to US blockchain analysis firm TRM Labs.

item.title: Nvidia's web of AI bets: smart strategy or bubble risk?
item.description: Nvidia's $3 billion investment in Meta's share sale, announced Tuesday, is the latest addition to a portfolio of stakes, loans and guarantees that has made the chip giant what some analysts describe as the central bank of the artificial intelligence boom. Nvidia also has around $36 billion in cloud backstops and a guarantee of up to $105 billion linked to an OpenAI data center, according to US media.

item.title: Salesforce to buy defense tech firm Rune in military business push
item.description: Business software maker Salesforce said on Thursday it would buy defense technology company Rune Technologies to expand its Missionforce business, which serves the US military and government agencies.

item.title: Rivian says it's on track for $250 million Uber funding by year-end, R2 demand strong
item.description: The Uber funding and strong R2 sales are crucial to Rivian's push to narrow heavy losses and cash burn while it funds a bet on self-driving technology and leans on its joint venture with Volkswagen, which has become a major source of revenue.

item.title: Nvidia in talks to give credit support for Nscale's deal with Anthropic
item.description: Nvidia is in talks to offer AI cloud provider Nscale billions of dollars in credit guarantees to support debt funding for a data center earmarked for Anthropic, The Information reported on Thursday, citing people with knowledge of the talks.

item.title: Tech firms take fresh hit as earnings misses fan AI fears
item.description: Tech firms were again on the back foot Friday after another round of disappointing earnings from Wall Street titans fanned already deep concerns about the AI investment boom. "The concern isn't that AI demand has already slowed.

item.title: Reddit posts search traffic declines, will push visitor sign-ins to curb data scraping
item.description: Reddit CEO Steve Huffman outlined a plan on Thursday to make signing-in mandatory for most content as the company grapples with data scraping and declining search referral traffic in recent months.

item.title: Amazon projects fourth quarter sales below estimates
item.description: It expects revenue of between $240.0 billion and $247.0 billion in the fourth quarter, compared with analysts' average estimate of $244.51 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG.

item.title: Bitcoin, cryptocurrency prices fall after Binance reports security issue
item.description: Cryptocurrency prices fell on Friday after Binance reported a potential security issue and said more than $2.5 billion in assets had been frozen. Bitcoin dropped to a six

item.title: Rising tech costs drive EMI sales; Shadowfax Q2 profit soars
item.description: Happy Friday! Shoppers are turning to EMIs as electronics prices rise. This and more in today’s ETtech Morning Dispatch.

item.title: Cyberattacks hit NBFCs; Pine Labs Q2 profit zooms
item.description: Cyber criminals are targetting smaller NBFCs with specialised AI toolkits. This and more in today’s ETtech Top 5.

item.title: India’s Crypto market has entered its next chapter
item.description: India's digital asset landscape is rapidly transforming, attracting participants across diverse sectors even amid regulatory hurdles. Coinbase's revival highlights the global acknowledgment of India's promising market for digital assets. Innovations like stablecoins and tokenization are reshaping payment mechanisms and asset accessibility. A self-regulatory framework is proposed to promote transparency, responsibility, and creativity in the industry.

item.title: Equentis Wealth Advisory Services leads investor awareness drive against equity market fraud
item.description: Equentis Wealth Advisory Services held a crucial investor awareness seminar in Bengaluru, focusing on the rising threat of cybercrime and online investment scams. With Dr. Satyapal Singh as the Chief Guest, expert speakers outlined current fraudulent strategies and emphasized the importance of investor vigilance. Participants were encouraged to rigorously check investment platforms and recognize deceptive online advertising.

item.title: As crypto markets mature, technical analysis moves to the core of investor strategy
item.description: Crypto investing has evolved from hype-driven participation to a focus on technical analysis and structured decision-making. Investors are now using tools to analyze price movements and market trends effectively. Technical analysis helps investors remove emotions from trading and create a repeatable system for decision-making. Additionally, many traders combine technical analysis with fundamental research to inform their investment choices.

item.title: Alphabet's heavy cloud spending drives bigger-than-expected cash burn
item.description: The company reported negative free cash flow of $9.07 billion, compared with analysts' estimate of a cash burn of $36 million, according to data compiled by LSEG.

item.title: STMicro nearly doubles quarterly profit, sees Q4 sales exceeding $4 billion
item.description: STMicroelectronics reported a third-quarter operating profit above market expectations on Thursday, as demand from AI data centres and satellite operators added to a broader recovery in the chipmaker's markets.

item.title: Marvell in advanced talks to buy Lumentum: Bloomberg News
item.description: Marvell has emerged as one of the biggest beneficiaries of the AI boom, driven by strong demand for its custom AI chips and networking hardware that connect data center servers and artificial intelligence systems.
